content_preview.title: Apertus 1.5 Adds Image and Audio Input, a 262,144-Token Context and a Thinking Mode to Its Fully Open 8B and 70B Models
content_preview.summary: The Apertus project's 1.5 release adds image and audio understanding, an optional thinking mode and a 262,144-token window to its 8B and 70B open models, under Apache 2.0.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

The Apertus project has published release notes and a technical report for Apertus 1.5, an update to its 8B and 70B models that adds image and audio understanding, an optional thinking mode, a context window four times longer than Apertus 1.0 and improved instruction-following and tool use, according to the [project's release notes on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/swiss-ai/apertus-v15-release-notes). editor_notes.content_quality: 779 words (News range 400-1200). Clear structure: overview, contents, training pipeline, benchmark claims, availability, unknowns. Appropriate technical depth.
editor_notes.source_verification: Both snapshots read from disk (decompressed, text-extracted): source-0.html.gz (Hugging Face community blog 'Apertus 1.5 Release Notes', published October 15, 2026, authored by Apertus team members; 200, full content, not thin) and source-1.html.gz (arXiv:2610.15542 abstract page, submitted 11 Oct 2026, 200, abstract present in full). Snapshots are complete so no live re-fetch was needed. suspicious_patterns null for both. Verified against source-0: weights released July 24, 2026 under Apache 2.0; notes dated Oct 15; 4T/2T additional tokens, totals 19T/17T; early-fusion discrete tokens, Emu3.5 (512x512 -> 1,024 tokens), WavTokenizer 40 tokens/s, vocabulary-only extension, text-only output, spoken language experimental; 262,144 context = 4x, extended 8k to 262k in long-context stage; four pretraining stages; more than half text-only; FineWeb2-HQ+, FinePDFs, Nemotron-CC; robots.txt opt-outs retroactive; five post-training stages, 3.7M text SFT samples, ~350k RL prompts, SDPO charter alignment 8B only and 70B final = DPO (per table); intermediate checkpoints base/SFT/RLVR/DPO; Gemma 4 12B comparison; Last Translation Benchmark (8B matches GPT-OSS-20B, outperforms Claude Haiku 4.5 and Google Translate); EvalEval/Every Eval Ever, 56 of 60 elements, Article 55 EU AI Act and GPAI Code of Practice; Proton Lumo and Infomaniak Euria; Swisscom, Infomaniak, Phoeniqs API access; Apertus 2.0 roadmap at AI+X Summit Zurich (sparse/MoE, ~600B total, agents/math/coding). Verified against source-1: thinking is a chat-template flag, up to 20 points math gain on 8B; 4T/2T tokens, fourfold to 262,144; 8B leads among fully open models of its class on knowledge, instruction following, cultural benchmarks; specialized vision/audio models remain ahead on English/high-resource perception and transcription. Direct quote 'While still trailing frontier open-weight models,' appears verbatim in source-0 ('While still trailing frontier open-weight models, the new release has also significantly improved performance in coding and instruction following...'). All other quote-marked text is that single fragment. No orphan URLs: every body URL is in article.sources (set difference empty). huggingface.co and arxiv.org are allowlisted.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Every number, date, model name and attribution traced to a snapshot; no discrepancies. Benchmark claims are correctly framed as developer self-reporting ('All comparisons below are the developers' own reporting'), and the source notes the arXiv abstract's claims are also authors' own. Minor framing note: the HF post is a 'Community Article' on the swiss-ai org written by team members; the article calls it the project's release notes, which is fair since the authors are project members. The 'nearly three months' gap (Jul 24 to Oct 15) is accurate arithmetic (~2.7 months) and is in a clearly labeled unknowns section.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral, attribution-heavy, no promotional language or AI self-reference.
editor_notes.originality: No existing Apertus coverage in src/content/articles. New topic.
concerns: Both sources are first-party (the developers' own blog and paper); no independent replication, which the article discloses explicitly.
recommendations: Where available, add an independent source (third-party evaluation or press) for benchmark claims in future coverage.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, well-sourced and properly hedged News piece. Writer-skipped checks run by the editor: validate:content passes, orphan-link diff empty, word count 779 within range. APPROVE.
